description: Leave a value that can be read exactly once by another agent, so a secret or capability passes between agents without appearing in any transcript. Use this when you delegate to a sub-agent or hand work to a later session.

key.description: Name the next agent will read from.

read_once.description: Whether the value disappears after one read. Defaults to true.

ttl_sec.description: Seconds before the value expires unread. Defaults to 1 hour.

name: handoff_dead_drop
